Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
I noticed that the card list (csv format) sometimes mentions flavor text that has been never printed, such as:

Condemnation: Betrayed

"But the Brujah are not as disciplined. Betrayal swiftly shifts their focus.
Sargon, Baali"

The card has never been reprinted so it's not a reprint issue.

I guess there are some other missing flavor texts.

Prince of Paris, France
